copy.lede: Desmond and his team at PeakGuard sort leaking roofs, flat roofs, fascias and guttering around Slough. Customers say it's no messing about: straight to the problem, fixed properly, at a fair price.

reviews: There's no other better way to define professionalism than this. No messing around straight to the point roof rectification of my long lasting leakage and moving pieces. Considerable price also. Will recommend to anyone looking for a true roofer Desmond and he’s team are fantastic cheers guys
Top company to use from start to finish can only highly recommend and will use again👌
